claims.label: Summary
claims.explanation: If enacted, HB 110 would require employers, except as provided by Labor Code §62.057, to pay each employee at least the greater of $15 an hour or the federal minimum wage. It would also repeal Labor Code §62.151, whose subject is not stated in the bill text.
Changes the statutory minimum wage employers must pay employees.
claims.label: Labor & workforce

claims.explanation: The bill amends the Texas Labor Code's general minimum-wage provision.
claims.label: Statewide

claims.explanation: Their statutory wage floor would be at least $15 an hour or the higher federal minimum, subject to the existing Section 62.057 exception.
claims.label: Employees covered by the minimum-wage requirement

claims.explanation: They would be required to comply with the revised minimum-wage floor, subject to the stated exception.
claims.label: Employers

claims.explanation: Would require payment of the greater of $15 an hour or the federal minimum wage, except as provided by Section 62.057.
claims.label: Sets a $15 minimum-wage floor

claims.explanation: The bill repeals the section, but its subject and resulting legal effect are not identified in the supplied text.
